note: Cortical visual impairment is documented in a minority of MAPK8IP3 patients (2 of 13 individuals, or ~15%, in the initial cohort, specifically associated with the p.Arg1146Cys missense variant).

evidence.text: Platzer et al. reported de novo MAPK8IP3 variants across 13 unrelated individuals and observed cortical visual impairment in two individuals with the p.Arg1146Cys missense variant (2/13, ~15%).

source.title: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with variable brain anomalies
source.quote: and the occurrence of spasticity and cortical visual impairment in two individuals with the p.Arg1146Cys variant.

numbers.metric: Affected individuals with cortical visual impairment in cohort

evidence.text: Crowder et al. report that de novo heterozygous variants in MAPK8IP3 present across a phenotypic spectrum that includes cortical visual impairment alongside features like scoliosis.

source.title: MAPK8IP3-Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder: Case Report and Therapeutic Rationale for a Truncating Variant
source.quote: novo heterozygous variants in MAPK8IP3 have a spectrum of … , scoliosis, and cortical visual impairment.
